name: A_LOOKUP_CVE
description: Offline CVE → CVSS + KEV status. Input: cve (case-normalized). Resolves against an embedded JSON cache of ~15 well-known CVEs (Log4Shell, Heartbleed, EternalBlue, MOVEit, …) with approximate CVSS scores and KEV flags. Unknown CVEs return { known: false } rather than throwing — fully offline, no network ever.
